cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(Stage1NativeSrcCandidate LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(CTest)
set(ENTROPY_MODULE_COPY_TO_SOURCE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(Shared/ModuleABI)
add_subdirectory(Modules/SRC)
add_executable(NativeReplayProbe NativeReplayProbe.cpp)
target_link_libraries(NativeReplayProbe PRIVATE EntropyModuleABI)
target_compile_features(NativeReplayProbe PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_definitions(NativeReplayProbe PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
